verified_claims: anderson_ksamp is a nonparametric k-sample distribution-comparison method
the no-tie continuous formula uses pooled ranks and the Scholz-Stephens right-side empirical-distribution statistic
the implementation accumulates weighted squared count discrepancies over every pooled-rank boundary
the public function supports a greater-tail permutation evaluation
small-sample permutation evaluation is preferable to relying on capped asymptotic interpolation
